name: ExpressLT™ Cable
description: Spinel's all-dielectric armored loose tube cable combines the benefits of loose tube cable with enhanced mechanical protection. It incorporates multiple layers of fiberglass for dielectric armoring, providing superior tensile strength and effective protection against small rodents.
specs: Mechanical and small rodent-retardant protection; Multiple layers of fiberglass armoring; Thicker outer jacket of high-density polyethylene (HDPE); Suitable for aerial lashed, duct, and direct buried applications; Up to 20-foot mid-span buffer tube storage capability; Easy routing in closures up to 432 fibers; Tested for resistance against small rodents; Guaranteed standards-based performance; Available with gel or dry buffer tubes;

name: ezDrop® Figure 8 Drop Cable
description: Spinel’s ezDROP® Figure 8 cable provides easy FTTx (Fiber-To-The-x) installation and termination using existing hardware and methods for drops to homes and businesses. The integrated steel messenger provides self-supporting strength up to 400 feet (125 meters) and serves as a toning wire for underground location.
specs: 3/32” stranded galvanized steel messenger; Compatible with existing figure 8 installation hardware; Tear-away messenger; Flexible buffer tube; Standard G657.A1 bend-sensitive single-mode fiber; Suitable for aerial lashed, duct

name: AeroLink™ Figure 8 Cable
description: AeroLink™ Figure 8 Cable features a self-supporting design that eliminates the need for over-lashing, permitting installation in a single pass with standard 1/4" EHS (6.6M) galvanized strand. The dimensions of the web, jacket, and strand are tailored for compatibility with standard hardware.
specs: Standard 1/4” EHS (6.6M) galvanized strand; Web, jacket and strand dimensions; Available with dry buffer tubes; Permits rapid cable preparation and termination; Water-blocking materials are easily removed; Low-friction installation; Excellent protection from environmental hazards; Telcordia GR-20, ICEA 640, and RUS PE90; EIA/TIA-455 series FOTPs for fiber optic cables

name: AeroLink™ Armored Figure 8 Cable
description: AeroLink™ Armored Figure 8 Cable features a self-supporting design that eliminates the need for over-lashing, enabling installation in a single pass using standard 1/4” EHS (6.6M) galvanized strand. The dimensions of the web, jacket, and strand are sized for standard hardware.
specs: Standard 1/4” EHS (6.6M) galvanized strand; Telcordia GR-20, ICEA 640, and RUS PE90; Relevant EIA/TIA-455 series FOTPs for fiber optic cables; Reverse Oscillated Lay Stranding

name: ExtremeLink® Cable
description: Spinel’s ExtremeLink® cables deliver robust performance for aerial lashed, duct, and direct-buried installations in extreme cold, rated to operate down to -50°C, including for double-armed cables. These heavy-duty loose-tube cables also support cold-temperature operation, with extended buffer-tube storage of up to 20 feet (6 meters), as required for certain outdoor plant pedestals and enclosures.
specs: Ripcord speeds cable entry; ezPREP® armor improves mid-span entry; 3.0 mm flexible buffer tubes; Suitable for aerial lashed, duct; Guaranteed standards-based performance to -50°C; Proven water-blocking;

name: LT 2.0 Gel Loose Tube Cable
description: Spinel’s LT2.0 Loose Tube Cable features an innovative design that offers numerous benefits. The LT2.0 is equipped with 2.0mm buffer tubes, resulting in a cable outer diameter (OD) up to 20% smaller than that of a standard loose tube cable with 2.5mm buffer tubes.
specs: Industry-leading bend-insensitive single-mode (SM) fiber; Available for up to 432 fibers; Reduced cable OD makes the LT2.0 30% lighter; Counts up to 456 can be placed in a 1-inch duct

name: 288 MicroFlex™ RICT Indoor/Outdoor Riser with FlexRibbon® Cable
description: MicroFlex™ RICT with FlexRibbon® technology features an ultracompact cable design that is suitable for both indoor and outdoor applications. It can contain up to 288 bend-insensitive fibers. The innovative FlexRibbon technology enables the fiber ribbons to be rolled up and tightly packed into a small-diameter central tube.
specs: Significantly smaller diameter; Lighter weight cables for easier installation and use of smaller ducts; 12 fiber ribbons are compatible; Uses standard 200 µm coated bend-insensitive fiber (ITU G657.A2)

name: Toneable Round Drop
description: Spinel’s versatile outdoor-rated drop for duct applications that contains a 1 or 2 fiber indoor riser-rated MDU cable and a 22 AWG tone wire. The subunit can be easily separated for routing into the dwelling. The tone wire allows for easy cable location in underground applications.
specs: Outdoor-rated cable contains 22 AWG wire for toning; Internal white 4.9mm round sub-unit (Riser/FT4 flame rated); MDU unit contains two EZstrip™ tight-buffered units; MDU sub-unit is compatible with stapling (T25 Round Crown Staples); Subunit is easily separated from the cable; EZstrip tight-buffered fibers for fast fiber stripping; Ripcords for easy removal of long sub-unit lengths;
